draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.83, the 2nd-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 2nd of 35 at WR. He went 4th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: CeeDee Lamb. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,211 receiving yards in 2023, 6th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Arizona Cardinals. 29 career games and 26 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 5 AV in 2025 against a career-best 8 in 2024. Weak spots: yards after catch per reception 2.9 (15th percentile), catch rate 56.2% (22nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 wide receiver who played: 608 receiving yards against a median of 290, above the norm.
